title: Arriving in a Yeti lair
description: A Yeti lair loads, its blocks nearly all ice, with the message "IT SMELLS LIKE WET FUR IN HERE!" The player runs right from the entrance and drops into the Yeti King's room, where he whips a Yeti and the Yeti King starts to yell.
